selection_stage: after label-free Foldseek connectivity audit and before any model fitting on this split

hard_components.edge_interpretation: both structures must achieve global TM-score at least 0.5; one-sided substructure containment is insufficient
hard_components.transitivity: connected components over every exact-equality and Foldseek hard edge

label_free_selection_rule.priority: lowest-threshold reciprocal_min, then geometric_mean, then reciprocal_max

post_construction_gates: zero PDB and exact endpoint sequence overlap
US-align spot-checks around the Foldseek decision boundary
train-to-validation and train-to-test maximum similarity audit
test_policy: The test role remains sealed from architecture, checkpoint, calibration, threshold, and seed selection.
claim_boundary: This protocol chooses a label-free structural split rule. It is not a model result and does not authorize a generalization claim.
